author: Insight I
title: Insight I: Mechanistic Probe - Feature Variance After Channel Attention (Test-Only, Filename Fix)
abstract: This test-only submission implements a mechanistic probe to investigate the impact of the `SqueezeExcitationBlock` on feature representation variance within Nomos II's `SingleStepWideLSTM` SOTA architecture. This is a corrected resubmission, addressing the `AttributeError: 'Config' object has no attribute 'FLAGS'` by using `time.time()` for filename generation. By comparing the feature variance and magnitude after the CNN backbone in both the base SOTA and the channel-attention-integrated version, this probe aims to provide quantitative evidence for the 'feature distortion' hypothesis. The results will be logged to lineage storage.

original_submission.content:
import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import flax.linen as nn
from typing import Tuple, Optional, Dict, Any
import json
import os
from env import create_train_env 
import time # Added for unique filename generation

jax.config.update("jax_disable_jit", False)

class SqueezeExcitationBlock(nn.Module):
    """Squeeze-and-Excitation block for channel-wise attention."""
    reduction_ratio: int = 16

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x: jnp.ndarray) -> jnp.ndarray:
        num_channels = x.shape[-1]
        squeeze = jnp.mean(x, axis=(1, 2))
        excitation = nn.Dense(features=num_channels // self.reduction_ratio, name="se_dense1")(squeeze)
        excitation = nn.relu(excitation)
        excitation = nn.Dense(features=num_channels, name="se_dense2")(excitation)
        excitation = nn.sigmoid(excitation)
        excitation = jnp.expand_dims(jnp.expand_dims(excitation, axis=1), axis=1)
        return x * excitation

class ConvLSTMCellLN(nn.Module):
    features: int
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, carry, x):
        h, c = carry
        gates = nn.Conv(4 * self.features, (3, 3), padding='SAME', kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(jnp.concatenate([x, h], axis=-1))
        gates = nn.LayerNorm(epsilon=1e-5)(gates)
        i, f, g, o = jnp.split(gates, 4, axis=-1)
        i, f, o = nn.sigmoid(i), nn.sigmoid(f), nn.sigmoid(o); g = jnp.tanh(g)
        new_c = f * c + i * g
        new_h = o * jnp.tanh(new_c)
        return (new_h, new_c), new_h

class BottleneckBlock(nn.Module):
    features: int
    ratio: float = 0.25
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        mid = max(1, int(self.features * self.ratio))
        y = nn.Conv(mid, (1,1), padding='SAME', kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(x); y = nn.relu(y)
        y = nn.Conv(mid, (3,3), padding='SAME', kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(y); y = nn.relu(y)
        y = nn.Conv(self.features, (1,1), padding='SAME', kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(y)
        return nn.relu(x + y)

class SingleStepWideLSTM_Base_ProbeNetwork(nn.Module):
    cnn_features_1: int = 32
    cnn_features_2: int = 64
    conv_lstm_features: int = 96 
    dilation: int = 5
    bottleneck_ratio: float = 0.25

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x: jnp.ndarray, done: Optional[jnp.ndarray]):
        x_spat = x[..., :7]
        cnn_out = nn.Conv(self.cnn_features_1, (3,3), padding='SAME', kernel_dilation=(self.dilation, self.dilation), kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(x_spat)
        cnn_out = nn.relu(cnn_out)
        cnn_out = BottleneckBlock(self.cnn_features_1, ratio=self.bottleneck_ratio)(cnn_out)
        cnn_out = nn.Conv(self.cnn_features_2, (3,3), padding='SAME', kernel_dilation=(self.dilation, self.dilation), kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(cnn_out)
        cnn_out = nn.relu(cnn_out)
        cnn_out = BottleneckBlock(self.cnn_features_2, ratio=self.bottleneck_ratio)(cnn_out)
        return cnn_out

class SingleStepWideLSTM_ChannelAttention_ProbeNetwork(nn.Module):
    cnn_features_1: int = 32
    cnn_features_2: int = 64
    conv_lstm_features: int = 96 
    dilation: int = 5
    bottleneck_ratio: float = 0.25
    se_reduction_ratio: int = 16 

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x: jnp.ndarray, done: Optional[jnp.ndarray]):
        x_spat = x[..., :7]
        cnn_out = nn.Conv(self.cnn_features_1, (3,3), padding='SAME', kernel_dilation=(self.dilation, self.dilation), kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(x_spat)
        cnn_out = nn.relu(cnn_out)
        cnn_out = BottleneckBlock(self.cnn_features_1, ratio=self.bottleneck_ratio)(cnn_out)
        cnn_out = nn.Conv(self.cnn_features_2, (3,3), padding='SAME', kernel_dilation=(self.dilation, self.dilation), kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(cnn_out)
        cnn_out = nn.relu(cnn_out)
        cnn_out = BottleneckBlock(self.cnn_features_2, ratio=self.bottleneck_ratio)(cnn_out)
        
        cnn_out = SqueezeExcitationBlock(reduction_ratio=self.se_reduction_ratio)(cnn_out)
        return cnn_out

def test():
    hparams_nomos_sota = {
        'cnn_features_1': 32, 'cnn_features_2': 64, 'conv_lstm_features': 96,
        'dilation': 5, 'bottleneck_ratio': 0.25
    }
    hparams_nomos_sota_se = {**hparams_nomos_sota, 'se_reduction_ratio': 16}

    env = create_train_env(time_limit=120)
    batch_size = 4
    key = jax.random.PRNGKey(0)
    keys = jax.random.split(key, batch_size)
    
    obs_batch, _ = jax.vmap(env.reset)(keys)
    dummy_done = jnp.zeros((batch_size,), dtype=bool)

    net_base = SingleStepWideLSTM_Base_ProbeNetwork(**hparams_nomos_sota)
    net_se = SingleStepWideLSTM_ChannelAttention_ProbeNetwork(**hparams_nomos_sota_se)
    
    key, init_key_base, init_key_se = jax.random.split(key, 3)
    params_base = net_base.init(init_key_base, obs_batch, dummy_done)
    params_se = net_se.init(init_key_se, obs_batch, dummy_done)

    features_base = net_base.apply(params_base, obs_batch, dummy_done)
    features_se = net_se.apply(params_se, obs_batch, dummy_done)

    feature_variance_base = float(jnp.mean(jnp.var(features_base, axis=(1, 2, 3))))
    feature_variance_se = float(jnp.mean(jnp.var(features_se, axis=(1, 2, 3))))
    
    feature_magnitude_base = float(jnp.mean(jnp.sqrt(jnp.sum(jnp.square(features_base), axis=(1,2,3)))))
    feature_magnitude_se = float(jnp.mean(jnp.sqrt(jnp.sum(jnp.square(features_se), axis=(1,2,3)))))

    out = {
        "probe_type": "feature_variance_and_magnitude_after_cnn_backbone",
        "hparams_base": hparams_nomos_sota,
        "hparams_se": hparams_nomos_sota_se,
        "feature_variance_base": feature_variance_base,
        "feature_variance_se": feature_variance_se,
        "feature_magnitude_base": feature_magnitude_base,
        "feature_magnitude_se": feature_magnitude_se,
        "relative_variance_change": (feature_variance_se - feature_variance_base) / feature_variance_base if feature_variance_base != 0 else 'NaN',
        "relative_magnitude_change": (feature_magnitude_se - feature_magnitude_base) / feature_magnitude_base if feature_magnitude_base != 0 else 'NaN',
    }

    os.makedirs("storage/insight/results", exist_ok=True)
    path = f"storage/insight/results/feature_probe_tick_{int(time.time())}.json" 
    with open(path, "w") as f:
        json.dump(out, f, indent=2)
    print(f"DEBUG: {out}")
    print(f"Wrote {path}")
    return out
